lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: I found a little crowd, perhaps twenty people, standing about the great hole where it lay.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: The turf round it was charred black. Henderson and Ogilvy had gone off to breakfast.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Four or five boys sat on the edge, legs dangling, pelting the giant mass with stones.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Stop that, you boys! Leave it alone, and get back from the edge!

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Cyclists, my jobbing gardener, Gregg the butcher and his little boy. Hardly anyone spoke.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: I think they had hoped for a heap of charred corpses, and got an iron boiler.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: I clambered down into the pit, and fancied I felt a faint movement under my feet.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Close to, it looked like a rusty gas float, but the crack gleamed a strange metal.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: I was sure the Thing had come from Mars. But I doubted anything living was inside.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: I dreamed of manuscripts inside, coins, models. Yet it was rather too large for comfort.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: About eleven I walked home to Maybury. But I could not settle to my work.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: By afternoon the common had changed: cabs from the station, a lordly carriage, heaps of bicycles.

lines.speaker: unnamed_newspaper_boy
lines.text: Message received from Mars! Remarkable story from Woking!

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: In the pit I found Henderson, Ogilvy, and a tall fair man: Stent, the Astronomer Royal.

lines.speaker: ogilvy
lines.text: You there! Come down, will you? I need your help.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: I left the staring crowd behind me and slid down the hot sand to him.

lines.speaker: ogilvy
lines.text: Would you fetch Lord Hilton for us? We want a railing put up.

lines.speaker: stent
lines.text: Keep those boys back from the edge, there!

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: The growing crowd hampered the digging, the boys worst of all. They needed a railing.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: I was glad to go. It made me one of the privileged few inside the rail.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: The workmen had failed to unscrew the top. It gave them no grip.

lines.speaker: ogilvy
lines.text: Listen. Now and then, something still stirs in there.
